source.symbol: Plain and editable menulist fixture definitions
source.validation: Exact public Git source at the fixed comparison revision. Claims are static observations. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

text:
<menulist aria-label="Plain menu list">
    <menupopup>
      <menuitem value="foo" label="foo"/>
      <menuitem value="bar" label="bar"/>
    </menupopup>
  </menulist>

  <menulist is="menulist-editable" aria-label="Editable menu list">
    <menupopup>
      <menuitem value="foo" label="foo"/>
      <menuitem value="bar" label="bar"/>
    </menupopup>
  </menulist>

  <menulist is="menulist-editable"
            editable="true"
            width="100"
            aria-label="Editable text menu list">
    <menupopup>
      <menuitem value="foo" label="foo"/>
      <menuitem value="bar" label="bar"/>
    </menupopup>
